title: Quality Technical Director
text:
Own the division’s quality strategy end to end, covering product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and regulatory compliance. You’ll set the technical direction for how quality is planned, measured, investigated, and improved—so performance, safety, and compliance are consistently achieved across the business.
 
 
**What You’ll Lead**

* Build and manage a high-performing technical and quality team, defining ways of working, performance expectations, and robust escalation paths.
* Strengthen supplier performance through quality requirements, audits/assessments, and structured corrective action to reduce recurring issues.
* Drive root-cause investigations and resolution for customer quality problems, translating findings into durable process and product improvements.
* Ensure laboratory and manufacturing practices support reliable results, operational effectiveness, and measurable compliance.
* Embed continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product performance, reduce variation, and optimize quality outcomes.

This role suits a quality leader with deep technical judgment, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to bring data, compliance requirements, and practical process control together.
